io.milvus.v2.service.collection.request

Class AddFieldReq

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.milvus.v2.service.collection.request.AddFieldReq
  • Direct Known Subclasses:
    AddCollectionFieldReq, AddFunctionFieldReq

    public class AddFieldReq
extends Object
    Request parameters for adding a field to a collection schema, used by the addField schema builder and by the addCollectionField API.
